notes: Asking for a speed change now works however you happen to write the number. Crisp already understood "half speed", "2x speed" and "50% speed", but "0.5 speed", "play it at 0.4 speed" and "set it to 0.75 speed" got the unhelpful reply that it had not caught an edit in that — even though the speed being asked for was one it can do perfectly well. That was the parser being fussy about the unit rather than reading the request, and sixteen more ways of putting it now work. Anything from a tenth speed up to eight times faster is available, and asking for more than that is quietly met at the limit rather than refused.
